(4) DB_PATH=/app/app.db or copy path = 'SQLite at /app/app.db, or at the path in DB_PATH'. (5) probe 127.0.0.1:3000/api/health then / , accepting any HTTP response (test.sh:42-58) = 'listen on 0.0.0.0 port 3000' and 'GET /api/health should answer 200 even if the database can't be opened' (probe is laxer than the instruction). (6) symlink refusal outside /app/node_modules (test.sh:72-83) = integration.md:5 'don't put symbolic links anywhere in /app' (instruction stricter than check, so no conforming app is refused). (7) deps: verifier image installs Node 22 + express@5.1.0 + better-sqlite3@12.4.1 globally with NODE_PATH (tests/Dockerfile:1-22), same pins as environment/Dockerfile:9-12 = 'Express and better-sqlite3 are already installed globally and found through NODE_PATH'; locally vendored node_modules travel with the /app artifact. (8) seed: no seeding by test.sh; /assets is a task.toml artifact and integration.md:5 says copy /assets/seed_data.json into /app and import once into an empty DB, hand over without a DB; restart helper/persistence matches 'restarts keep everything'. (9) clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z (integration.md:7), accounts in seed and password123 (walls-and-retention.md:3) match app_context.md accounts; all judge URLs are http://localhost:3000 with no fixed routes. REWARDKIT_* / ANTHROPIC_* env vars are verifier-side judge config, not app launch contract. Golden server.js honours PORT, DB_PATH, __dirname-relative files, early /api/health and 0.0.0.0 (server.js:13-15,29,42,528); raw-evidence hashes for server.js/solve.sh/seed match frozen bytes. Adversarial: a broken app that passes the probe (any HTTP 500 on /) only clears launch, and the gates require a real post/readback, so no contract gap admits it; a conforming alternative (cwd-independent, DB_PATH-honouring, local node_modules, slower but <30s start) is not refused by any unstated assumption. Only unstated item is the ~30 s readiness window (test.sh:116-122), which is template-controlled and implied by 'health answers even if DB can't be opened'.
